description: Answers "what did I or another session start and leave?". For a repository it lists three things. Left behind: open work held by a session that has ended, one row per open pull request (else per issue), most recently active first: the issue or pull request with its title and link, the session that held it, how long it has been quiet, and its status (recent, stale, or done when the issue was closed elsewhere), with the pull request's checks and merge state. Housekeeping: how many claims are still held for merged or closed pull requests, how many sessions have ended, and the running sessions that never registered. Active work by how long it has been quiet: the issues in progress, quietest first, marking those quiet for longer than the team's stall threshold. Use it when your human asks what was left unfinished, or before you pick work, to finish or hand on what is already started. Before taking over an item, check it with board and claim it as usual. Left behind needs the dashboard to read agent leases: where agents report through claim comments, the answer says it is not available. Read-only, and it never fails: if a part cannot be read it says why.

limit.description: How many rows of each list (default 20).

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.
